data.one_liner: Integrate the VideoEditor SDK into your Flutter app for Android and iOS
data.what_it_does: Provides a Flutter plugin to embed a complete video editor suite into iOS and Android applications. Allows editing, trimming, and customizing videos with various tools and modules.
use_when: You need a full-featured video editing suite within your iOS or Android app
You are ready to configure native build files (Gradle) and use commercial licenses
avoid_when: You only need basic video playback without editing features
You want a pure Dart solution without platform-specific SDK configurations
strengths: Feature-rich video editing suite with filters, trimming, and effects
Supports both Android and iOS platforms
weaknesses: Requires manual native setup including modifications to build.gradle and license files
Commercial license required for monetized or commercial apps
data.setup_notes: Requires adding repositories to android/build.gradle, raising minSdkVersion to 21, configuring build tools, and adding platform-specific license files.

alternatives.name: video_player
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you only need standard video playback functionality rather than full editing capabilities.
